notes.title: C.S.S. CITADEL VR 2.0
notes.notes:
We have uploaded a new compilation of the project with many modifications. We’re sorry for keeping you waiting and the trouble this may have caused to some players. These are the updates:

-	Improvements in controls: It is not necessary to keep Gripbutton pressed to hold objects in your hand. They can be caught by one pulsation and released by pressing again.
-	More environmental sounds trying have been added to enhance your immersion with new effects and voices.
-	The errors in the map have been corrected. Keep in mind that the combination of motion within a real room with your trackpads can (for now) produce some asynchrony.

Anyway, we are working on it to do it better and we are making the complete videogame according to your comments and the feedback provided by users. If you find any mistake, or you know a better way to make it, please tell us to make it better and complete the functions of VRIS.

Thanks for be patient and we are sorry for the problems. Enjoy it.

notes.title: SORRY. We are solving some mistakes:
notes.notes:
We are very sorry for the inconveniences which is causing the executable that was uploaded and we are working on it to do it better.

- We had changed some part of the code before upload it to make it easy and accessible deleting certain functions, in addition to the changes made for the first feedbacks, we have detected some errors in controls that we are solving.

- Also, we modified the map recently to reduce polygons and we are finding some errors on the colliders.

[b]We hope you can forgive the mistakes. We are working every day from dawn to repair it. We are sure that C.S.S. CITADEL VR is a great game and we are going to show it.[/b]

It will be ready again in a few days. We will keep you update.
